competitiveTarget: Beat Coldwell Banker / Windermere city pages — live neighborhood-level market data no competitor surfaces (EXECUTION_PLAN §8 rank 1).
note: Wave 3 rebuild target. The current app/cities/[slug]/page.tsx is the LEGACY implementation (components/city/*, components/geo-page/*, app/actions/* — not DAL, not Wave 2 primitives). This contract is BASELINED in scripts/mockup-parity-baseline.json until the rebuild lands; G6 fails on NEW missing components beyond that baseline. The rebuild swaps to the components below, all of which already exist as Wave 2 Layer 3 blocks.

requiredComponents.name: SiteHeader
requiredComponents.section: site chrome — navy bar, horizontal logo, 15px nav (D73/D74)
requiredComponents.notes: Usually rendered by app/layout.tsx; listed so the parity contract documents the full surface.

requiredComponents.name: HeroBlock
requiredComponents.section: hero — 'Homes for sale in {City}, Oregon' + lede + canonical Old Mill photo + Ken Burns
requiredComponents.notes: Replaces components/city/CityHero. D28 Ken Burns + D35 canonical hero inherited from the primitive.

requiredComponents.name: MarketSnapshot
requiredComponents.section: '{City} housing market' — 4 stat cards from getMarketStats + getMarketPulse (active count, median list, median DOM, months of supply)
requiredComponents.notes: Replaces components/city/CityMarketStats + CityOverview. Data through @/lib/data — getMarketStats('city', slug) + getMarketPulse.

requiredComponents.name: PriceRangeTiles
requiredComponents.section: 'Browse {City} homes by budget' — price-bracket tiles linking to filtered search

requiredComponents.name: OpenHousesGrid
requiredComponents.section: 'Open houses · {weekend}' — this city's upcoming open houses
requiredComponents.notes: Renders nothing when no open houses scheduled.

requiredComponents.name: RelatedAreas
requiredComponents.section: 'Explore by neighborhood' — neighborhood + community cross-nav tiles with active counts

requiredComponents.name: ActivityFeed
requiredComponents.section: 'What's happening right now' — recent activity rows (new/price-drop/pending/sold)

requiredComponents.name: CTABar
requiredComponents.section: 'Local brokers. Specific numbers. No pressure.' — contact CTA band

requiredComponents.name: SiteFooter
requiredComponents.section: navy footer — license #201206613, dotted phone, hyphen URL, middle-dot separator (D65)

deferredComponents.name: ListingsGrid
deferredComponents.reason: Featured + newest listings render via the homes-for-sale search surface; the city page links to it rather than embedding a full grid per the mockup.

deferredComponents.name: FAQBlock
deferredComponents.reason: City FAQ is a Wave 3 content-pass addition once per-city Q/A copy is written.
